items.title: El portero eléctrico
items.context: Freddy llama al portero eléctrico. Contesta Celeste.

lines.en: Hello. I am looking for Don Ramón.
Hello. Who is it?

lines.text: Soy Freddy. Traigo una mudanza para el cuarto B.
lines.en: I am Freddy. I am bringing a move for 4B.

lines.text: Don Ramón está en la terraza. Baja en cinco minutos.

Thank you. It is very cold here.

choice.qEn: Which flat is the move for?

open.qEn: Where do you live?

items.context: Nahuel trae un paquete. Elvira está en el hall.
items.contextEn: Nahuel brings a parcel. Elvira is in the hall.

lines.text: Buenas tardes. Tengo un paquete para el cuarto B.
lines.en: Good afternoon. I have a parcel for 4B.

lines.text: Es la persona nueva. Llega hoy.
lines.en: It is the new person. They arrive today.
Will you sign, madam?

lines.text: No, no. Yo soy Elvira, del primero A.
lines.en: No, no. I am Elvira, from 1A.
OK, I will wait here.

items.title: Una pregunta
items.context: Federico está en el consultorio. Habla con Marta, su psicóloga.

lines.en: Hi, Federico. How are you today?
Bad. I am afraid of the lift.
Why?

lines.text: El martes no funciona. Estoy cuarenta minutos dentro.
lines.en: On Tuesday it does not work. I am inside for forty minutes.
And now do you use the stairs?
Yes. Always.

choice.qEn: How many minutes is he inside?

open.qEn: Are you afraid of something?
open.model: Sí, tengo miedo de las arañas.

items.context: Thiago toca la batería. Su mamá, Noelia, habla con él.
items.contextEn: Thiago plays the drums. His mum, Noelia, talks to him.

lines.text: Thiago, son las ocho. Basta, por favor.
lines.en: Thiago, it is eight o'clock. Enough, please.

lines.text: Mamá, el sábado es el concurso.
lines.en: Mum, the contest is on Saturday.

lines.text: Ya sé. Pero los vecinos duermen.
lines.en: I know. But the neighbours sleep.
Ten more minutes, please.
Five. And quietly.

choice.qEn: How many more minutes does Thiago ask for?
How many minutes does Noelia give him?

open.qEn: Do you play an instrument?

items.title: Agua en la casa
items.context: Carla llama a Wilson por teléfono. Hay agua en el techo.
items.contextEn: Carla phones Wilson. There is water in the ceiling.

lines.en: Wilson, there is water in the living room!
Again? Where?

lines.text: En el techo, encima del sofá.
lines.en: In the ceiling, above the sofa.

lines.text: Pon un balde. Llego en diez minutos.
lines.en: Put a bucket. I arrive in ten minutes.
I already have three buckets.

choice.qEn: How many buckets does Carla have?

open.qEn: Do you have a sofa at home?

items.title: Catorce gatos

items.contextEn: Pocha talks to Gastón, the plumber. There are many cats.

lines.en: Gastón, do you want some tea?
Yes, thank you, madam. How many cats do you have?
Fourteen. This is Rulo.

lines.text: Es muy bonito. Pero aquí no hay agua.
lines.en: He is very pretty. But there is no water here.
Then have the tea.

choice.qEn: How many cats does Pocha have?

open.qEn: Do you have cats or dogs?

items.contextEn: Yuliana works at home. Wilson knocks on the door.

lines.text: Hola, señorita. ¡Hay agua en mi casa!
lines.en: Hello, miss. There is water in my home!
Sorry, I am in a meeting.
Your bathtub! It is open!
Oh, no! I am very sorry.
Please, close it now!

open.qEn: Do you work at home?
open.model: Sí, a veces trabajo en casa.

open.qEn: Do you have online meetings?

lines.en: Nerea, the code does not work.
What number is it?
One, two, three, four.

lines.text: Prueba al revés: cuatro, tres, dos, uno.
lines.en: Try it backwards: four, three, two, one.
Yes! It is open!

open.qEn: Do you travel a lot?

lines.text: Señora, esta es la última caja.
lines.en: Madam, this is the last box.

lines.text: Muy bien. Ponla en la cocina.
lines.en: Very good. Put it in the kitchen.
It is very heavy. What is inside?
Books, I think.

choice.qEn: What is inside, according to Amalia?

open.qEn: Do you have many books?

items.contextEn: Don Washington talks about his wife, Elsa.

lines.en: This is Elsa, my wife.

lines.text: Bailamos tango cuarenta y tres años.
lines.en: We danced tango for forty-three years.

lines.text: La conozco en el ascensor, en 1971.
lines.en: I meet her in the lift, in 1971.

lines.en: The lift does not work. I sing tangos.

lines.en: Hi, Pochoclo. Come in, please.
Hello! Happy birthday! How old is Benjamín?
Six. There are ten children.
Perfect! I have balloons and music.
Oh, the children are crying!

lines.en: Don Aurelio, what is this?

lines.en: It is my coffin. It is made of wood.
But you are very well!

lines.text: Sí. Tengo noventa y un años. Y está barato.
lines.en: Yes. I am ninety-one. And it is cheap.
Oh, my God!

choice.qEn: What is in the living room?
Why does he buy it, according to him?

open.qEn: How old are you?
